issue.title: Interface method signature for cglib.proxy.CallbackFilter different between github and Maven built Jar
issue.body:
After trying to use Powermock 1.6.2 with a Mockito 1.10.19 jar built from source on my own laptop led to:

```
AbstractMethodError: org.powermock.api.mockito.repackaged.ClassImposterizer$2.accept(java.lang.Method, java.util.List<Method>)
```

However, with the prebuilt jar for mockito-all 1.10.19 from Maven central works perfectly with Powermock 1.6.2.

After some digging, I found that the method signatures for org.mockito.cglib.proxy.CallbackFilter#accept are different between what's there in github source and what's there in the Maven central built jar. The signatures are:

Github source: accept(Method method, List<Method> methods)
Maven built jar: accept(Method method)

Powermock 1.6.2. is using the latter

Just wondering why there is such a discrepancy?
